notes:
User is building their Instagram presence around writing and recently reached 600 followers (up from 500), which they consider a nice milestone. They especially enjoy behind-the-scenes content, and their cat, Luna, is popular with followers, so they may feature her in the writing process. Their preferred content strategy is a consistent hybrid approach: share manuscript excerpts as sections are completed while maintaining a steady posting rhythm, rather than relying entirely on a strict “Manuscript Monday” schedule or random posting.

They plan to engage followers by asking what content they want most through an Instagram Story poll with three options: “More writing tips and advice,” “More behind-the-scenes content,” and “More sneak peeks of my manuscript.” They also want to invite comments and further opinions. Afterward, they plan to share a concise, visually appealing follow-up Story thanking participants, highlighting the winning option, explaining what they learned, and possibly teasing upcoming content based on the results.

The user is now planning an Instagram Story Q&A session using the “Question Sticker” for a quick, easy start. They will announce it in advance, use a branded hashtag, and specify the topic: their writing process and experiences as a freelancer. They may promote it with an attention-grabbing visual, a clear call to action, and a specified time. Their goals are to increase likes, comments, and sustained follower growth; make content feel authentic and personal; involve followers in content decisions; and potentially encourage user-generated content in the future.

Their Q&A reminder copy is:
“Hey everyone! 🙋‍♀️ Just a quick reminder that I'll be hosting a Q&A session in my Instagram Story tomorrow! 🤔 Ask me anything about my writing process, freelancing, or anything else you're curious about. 📝 Use the ‘Question Sticker’ to submit your questions, and I'll do my best to answer as many as I can. 🙏 Thanks for participating, and I'm looking forward to chatting with you all tomorrow! 😊 #QandAwith[YourName] #WritingCommunity #FreelanceLife”

Potential improvements discussed: add a visual/GIF, specify the session time, and clarify the theme or focus. The example revised copy included “tomorrow at 10am EST,” but this is optional and should only be used if accurate.

For the Q&A, the user does not need to answer every question. They plan to:
- Answer a manageable selection of the most relevant, interesting, or representative questions.
- Combine repeated questions by addressing common themes.
- Keep answers concise and engaging.
- Provide additional resources for topics that cannot be fully covered.
- Set expectations transparently by saying they will answer as many as possible.
- Mention that unanswered questions may be addressed in a future post or Q&A session.
- Thank participants and possibly encourage them to share takeaways.
- Follow up afterward to build trust and sustain community interest.

They should still consider collecting questions in advance and clarifying whether responses will be shared through Stories, a feed post, comments, or another format.
